caption: A, B, D and F run back to back from day 0 to day 14 with zero slack, so they set the finish date. F waits for both D and E, so it starts at day 12, the later of the two finishes, while C and E each keep 4 days of slack.

spec.title: Six tasks: earliest start, earliest finish and slack, in days
spec.aria: Network of six tasks: A starts at day 0; B and C follow A; D follows B and E follows C; F starts after both D and E at day 12, giving a 14-day critical chain A-B-D-F, while C and E each have 4 days of slack.
